018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.bucket;
019
020import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.CacheConfig.BUCKETCACHE_PERSIST_INTERVAL_KEY;
021import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.bucket.BucketCache.DEFAULT_ERROR_TOLERATION_DURATION;
022import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
023import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
024import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
025
026import java.io.File;
027import java.io.FileOutputStream;
028import org.apache.hadoop.conf.Configuration;
029import org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path;
030import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseConfiguration;
031import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseTestingUtil;
032import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.CacheTestUtils;
033import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.io.hfile.Cacheable;
034import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.protobuf.ProtobufMagic;
035import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.RegionServerTests;
036import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.SmallTests;
037import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
038import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
039
040/**
041 * Tests for HBASE-29857: BucketCache recovery should gracefully handle empty or truncated
042 * persistence files instead of throwing NullPointerException.
043 * <p>
044 * These tests verify that the cache recovers gracefully when the persistence file contains only
045 * magic bytes without actual cache data. The fix adds null checks that throw IOException instead of
046 * allowing NullPointerException to propagate.
047 */
048@Tag(SmallTests.TAG)
049@Tag(RegionServerTests.TAG)
050public class TestBucketCacheEmptyPersistence {
051
052  private static final long CAPACITY_SIZE = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
053  private static final int WRITE_THREADS = BucketCache.DEFAULT_WRITER_THREADS;
054  private static final int WRITER_QUEUE_LEN = BucketCache.DEFAULT_WRITER_QUEUE_ITEMS;
055
056  /**
057   * Test that BucketCache recovers gracefully when the persistence file contains only non-chunked
058   * format (PBUF) magic bytes without any cache data. This tests the null check fix in
059   * retrieveFromFile() for the non-chunked format path.
060   */
061  @Test
062  public void testEmptyPersistenceFileNonChunkedFormat() throws Exception {
063    HBaseTestingUtil testUtil = new HBaseTestingUtil();
064    Path testDir = testUtil.getDataTestDir();
065    testUtil.getTestFileSystem().mkdirs(testDir);
066
067    Configuration conf = HBaseConfiguration.create();
068    conf.setLong(BUCKETCACHE_PERSIST_INTERVAL_KEY, Long.MAX_VALUE);
069
070    String persistencePath = testDir + "/bucket.persistence";
071    File persistenceFile = new File(persistencePath);
072
073    // Create a persistence file with only PBUF magic bytes - no actual cache data
074    try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(persistenceFile)) {
075      fos.write(ProtobufMagic.PB_MAGIC);
076    }
077    assertTrue(persistenceFile.exists(), "Persistence file should exist");
078
079    int[] bucketSizes = new int[] { 8 * 1024 + 1024 };
080
081    // BucketCache should recover gracefully from the empty file
082    BucketCache bucketCache =
083      new BucketCache("file:" + testDir + "/bucket.cache", CAPACITY_SIZE, 8192, bucketSizes,
084        WRITE_THREADS, WRITER_QUEUE_LEN, persistencePath, DEFAULT_ERROR_TOLERATION_DURATION, conf);
085
086    // Cache should initialize successfully (not hang or throw)
087    assertTrue(bucketCache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000),
088      "Cache should initialize successfully after recovering from empty file");
089
090    // Verify the cache was reset (backing map should be empty since file had no valid data)
091    assertEquals(0, bucketCache.backingMap.size(),
092      "Backing map should be empty after recovering from empty persistence file");
093
094    // Verify the cache is usable - we can add and retrieve blocks
095    CacheTestUtils.HFileBlockPair[] blocks = CacheTestUtils.generateHFileBlocks(8192, 1);
096    bucketCache.cacheBlock(blocks[0].getBlockName(), blocks[0].getBlock());
097
098    // Wait for block to be written to cache
099    Thread.sleep(100);
100
101    // Verify block can be retrieved
102    Cacheable retrieved = bucketCache.getBlock(blocks[0].getBlockName(), false, false, false);
103    assertNotNull(retrieved, "Should be able to retrieve cached block");
104
105    bucketCache.shutdown();
106    testUtil.cleanupTestDir();
107  }
108
109  /**
110   * Test that BucketCache recovers gracefully when the persistence file contains only chunked
111   * format (V2UF) magic bytes without any cache data. This tests the null check fix in
112   * retrieveChunkedBackingMap().
113   */
114  @Test
115  public void testEmptyPersistenceFileChunkedFormat() throws Exception {
116    HBaseTestingUtil testUtil = new HBaseTestingUtil();
117    Path testDir = testUtil.getDataTestDir();
118    testUtil.getTestFileSystem().mkdirs(testDir);
119
120    Configuration conf = HBaseConfiguration.create();
121    conf.setLong(BUCKETCACHE_PERSIST_INTERVAL_KEY, Long.MAX_VALUE);
122
123    String persistencePath = testDir + "/bucket.persistence";
124    File persistenceFile = new File(persistencePath);
125
126    // Create a persistence file with only chunked format (V2UF) magic bytes - no actual cache data
127    try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(persistenceFile)) {
128      fos.write(BucketProtoUtils.PB_MAGIC_V2);
129    }
130    assertTrue(persistenceFile.exists(), "Persistence file should exist");
131
132    int[] bucketSizes = new int[] { 8 * 1024 + 1024 };
133
134    // BucketCache should recover gracefully from the empty file
135    BucketCache bucketCache =
136      new BucketCache("file:" + testDir + "/bucket.cache", CAPACITY_SIZE, 8192, bucketSizes,
137        WRITE_THREADS, WRITER_QUEUE_LEN, persistencePath, DEFAULT_ERROR_TOLERATION_DURATION, conf);
138
139    // Cache should initialize successfully (not hang or throw)
140    assertTrue(bucketCache.waitForCacheInitialization(10000),
141      "Cache should initialize successfully after recovering from empty file");
142
143    // Verify the cache was reset (backing map should be empty since file had no valid data)
144    assertEquals(0, bucketCache.backingMap.size(),
145      "Backing map should be empty after recovering from empty persistence file");
146
147    // Verify the cache is usable - we can add and retrieve blocks
148    CacheTestUtils.HFileBlockPair[] blocks = CacheTestUtils.generateHFileBlocks(8192, 1);
149    bucketCache.cacheBlock(blocks[0].getBlockName(), blocks[0].getBlock());
150
151    // Wait for block to be written to cache
152    Thread.sleep(100);
153
154    // Verify block can be retrieved
155    Cacheable retrieved = bucketCache.getBlock(blocks[0].getBlockName(), false, false, false);
156    assertNotNull(retrieved, "Should be able to retrieve cached block");
157
158    bucketCache.shutdown();
159    testUtil.cleanupTestDir();
160  }
161}
